scope: Human single-USB ETW reproduction. Diagnostic only; no drawing A/B, no algorithm or production edits. Preparation/build only tonight; no automatic field acquisition.
topology: Fresh full GUI per trial; original UsbWorker -> _GroundFrameInbox -> DeviceQualitySession -> GaitEngine, original NumPy and renderer. Original raw native MJPEG+CSV, SDK full-body tracking, real lower-body pose draw counters. No replay or second USB.
copied_runtime: field_runner.py and queue_probe.py byte-identical to single_usb_field revision 2. Human wrapper adds only start/end handshake, cancellation, two native boundary CPU snapshots with FILETIME/perf brackets, a visibly bordered confirmation button, and bounded existing-counter status text at the existing 1Hz tick. No new per-frame probe.
order_policy: Manual desktop entries, no automatic next trial. Save actual order/times. All trials retained, no repeat-until-pass. Human passes differ in input and body/camera load: OFF/ON is observational overhead calibration, not identical-input statistical equivalence. First complete walking block before deciding whether running is needed.

protocol.operator_confirmation: Head-to-toe visible, clear beams, actual SDK/pose drawing sustained; visibly bordered checkable confirmation button plus current original readiness. Numeric landmark gate alone is insufficient. Camera raw video starts during preparation as before.
protocol.ETW_handshake: After operator presses Start, external controller starts/checks the unique owned WPR collector, then atomic run-specific acknowledgement. GUI rechecks current readiness before requesting arm exactly once. Failure/30s wait cancels, never arms without matching acknowledgement. OFF uses same handshake without starting WPR.
protocol.formal: 5s empty, single outbound passage, leave outside beam lane, assistant clicks clear, 15s empty. Original 60s formal cap and 120s stop watchdog retained. Do not re-enter to repair a missing print or lost pose.
protocol.trace_span: Start before formal arming after preparation confirmation; stop requested after engine stop/draining, before report serialization. Always stop only owned instance on failure. Native CPU bracket spans approximately arm to stop request, excludes draining.
protocol.shutdown: SDK shutdown, no USB reader and serialized measurement must be confirmed before treating capture as completed. Known third-party native process exit wait may be terminated only after validated successful teardown; other failures explicitly invalid. Cancel/window close preserves failure evidence. Uncertain owned trace stop leaves lock for manual audit.

trace.profile: Same calibrated 64KB x128 buffer ProcessThread, Loader, CSwitch, ReadyThread profile; no stack or sampled CPU collection.
trace.prior_scope: 6 unmanned OFF/ON pairs passed at 47f1167, actual effective skeleton draws zero. Does not validate dense/human observer or tracing overhead.
trace.interpretation_gate: No Running/Ready/Waiting attribution until CSwitch v5 payload decoding and FILETIME/perf alignment independently checked against GetThreadTimes. Existing tracerpt XML shows +07:59 inconsistent with system +08:00; do not trust that rendered offset. Scheduling alone cannot prove GIL/GC.

offline_metrics: Freeze these definitions before first new capture: use existing actual pending/oldest receipt age/batch state. Separate initial 5s empty, full formal, 1s device-density bins and each contiguous dense block >=2s; dense >=50% usable contact, empty <=1%, after only original bad mask. Report enqueue/consumer fps, age slope, pending max, head P95/max, receipt-to-first-paint P95/max, first sampled fully-empty witness after dense-block end. No precision claim for physical last-step recovery; isolated beam64 pulses are separately visible. Paint latency excludes unpublished events.
reproduction_gate: Dense block >=2s: actual enqueue >=990fps, consumer <970fps, pending >=100 and head age >=100ms with a continuous observed heavy span >=1s (reset continuity on any >250ms sample gap), completed receipt age slope >10ms/device-second. Report broad and dense results separately; predeclared here for new trials, do not rewrite older acceptance. One positive trial is not stable repeat reproduction.
load_gate: Require actual valid skeleton draws in each observed contact interval and inspect original outbound video for full-body visibility, plus raw bytes/counters/no drops, final empty queue and closed SDK. Mid-contact pose loss remains captured but fails matched-load coverage; SDK checkbox/start result alone insufficient. Report absolute node/link/draw counts, contact density, duration and SDK calls when pairing trials.
overhead_gate: For comparable OFF/ON human pairs only: report primary host3..19s consumer delta (abs <=20fps), head P95 increase <=20ms, preview ratio[0.9,1.1], native recorded fps ratio[0.95,1.05], whole-arm-stop CPU increment <=10%; also report dense-window deltas/load differences. Human variability, unmatched bone load, short windows or fewer than 2 pairs per mode => inconclusive, not passed calibration. Require actual ETL CSwitch/ReadyThread and zero event/buffer losses. Consumer capped at 1000Hz is not a capacity gain.
correctness_boundary: Walking last-step publication and effective-step/cycle counting, running 8 vs6 footprints remain independent. Preserve original reports/quality/audits and optional human ground truth separately; no retrospective starting-foot/threshold edits.
